scope: Tiny environment smoke tests only. These are not study queries, study cases, benchmarks, theorem checks, or evidence of natural-language interpretation.

sympy_installation_clarification.reason: After discovery found SymPy absent from the staging venv, the parent explicitly authorized an isolated staging-only install. The predeclared matrix case and expected values are unchanged.

sympy.original_policy: Run only from an already importable SymPy installation; do not install SymPy for this pass.
sympy.effective_policy: The later recorded clarification permits sympy==1.14.0 to be installed only in this staging venv; no system or platform changes.

other_runtimes.policy: Version or help smoke only if already installed and invocation cannot trigger a toolchain download. Do not install SageMath, Lean, Loogle, Mathlib, Isabelle, Nitpick, WSL distributions, or system Z3.
